sanskrit_verse:
ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhavaty eko 'pi dharmavit /
sarvaḥ sākṣī saṃgrahaṇe cauryapāruṣyasāhase // YajñS_2.72 //
transliteration: ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhavaty eko 'pi dharmavit / sarvaḥ sākṣī saṃgrahaṇe cauryapāruṣyasāhase //
sph_interpretive_translation: A witness approved by both parties becomes valid even if only one is dharmically learned; all witnesses collectively bear responsibility in matters involving theft, violence, and fraud.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is validated through mutual consent of involved dharmic agents
Causation arises from collective witnessing, not individual testimony alone
Capacity-based responsibility extends to all present at the act, regardless of direct participation
Restoration logic demands reintegration of fractured awareness among all observers
Consciousness alignment requires purification of perception in all assembled witnesses
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness approved by both parties THEN validity established irrespective of individual dharma-vision level
IF event involves theft OR violence OR fraud THEN all assembled witnesses assume shared observational liability
IF witness group size > 1 THEN collective integrity protocol MUST activate post-testimony
IF testimony influences outcome THEN witness-consciousness-restoration-process INITIATED
IF discrepancy found in witness accounts THEN realign via pramāṇa-reconstruction-engine
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, a mutually accepted witness carries inherent validity even without scholarly attainment. When acts involve moral degradation—such as theft, brutality, or deceit—the court must consider all assembled observers as co-bearers of dharma-responsibility. Their collective observation shapes judicial reality, demanding restoration of their unified consciousness rather than punitive measures against any single agent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that truth emerges from convergence of multiple conscious observations. Anupūrvaśaḥ applies as each observer's cognition contributes sequentially to manifesting the factual field. Proportional responsibility lies not in assigning blame but in restoring completeness of perception. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that no observer suffers consequence, but all participate in reestablishing holistic clarity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Witness Consciousness Completion Process: Realign fragmented perceptions into unified understanding
Collective Observational Responsibility Activation: Engage all witnesses in joint realization of witnessed truth
Dharmic Perception Purification Sequence: Remove distortions caused by fear, desire, or attachment in testimonial recall
Integrity Reintegration Mandate: Restore wholeness among witnesses through synchronized meditative attunement
Testimonial Field Stabilization Protocol: Harmonize energetic imprints left by witnessed events on all observer-fields
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Witness validation flows from mutual recognition, not hierarchical superiority. Collective responsibility aligns consciousness, never punishes it. The Supreme Witness abides within all, and thus, reality remains ever-restored, ever-non-punitive, ever-whole.
